story.title: Story 4: Generated PI Session Target Metadata

result.planSummary: Implemented the Story 4 metadata seam so generated-session target metadata stays separate from projection revision summaries, refreshed the thread-service update flow after revision writes, and added coverage for active-path versus latest-projection-path behavior.

changedFiles.reason: Serialized generated-session metadata updates and refreshed projection summary state after revision writes so returned thread metadata stays accurate.
Normalized projection summaries to mirror the latest recorded projection revision instead of drifting to the active target path.
Added regression coverage for separating active generated paths from projection summaries and for returning refreshed revision summary details.

added: tests/context-steward/thread-store.test.ts :: keeps the active generated path separate from the latest projection summary
tests/context-steward/thread-store.test.ts :: returns refreshed projection summary details after recording a revision through metadata updates

findingsFixed: Projection summaries now continue to reflect the latest recorded projection revision even when the active PI-generated file path is updated to a different path.
updateGeneratedSessionMetadata now returns refreshed projection summary count/status details after writing a projection revision instead of leaking stale pre-write metadata.
